description: Full-text-derived body excerpts, not abstracts. A deliberately null/negative-enriched challenge set; not an estimate of literature prevalence. Labels were selected from original findings before any trial model output. Context is part of interpretation, not part of the normalized triple matching key.
annotation_policy: supports asserts the named relation; no_effect is a measured zero/null versus untreated control; refutes explicitly denies the relation (including ineffective or no resistant isolates). Comparisons between two effective treatments are not null efficacy. Resistance findings support resistant_to, not controls. Entity expansions resolve abbreviations using the paper. These are hand-checked author-of-fixture annotations, not independent expert adjudication.
offset_convention: All ranges are zero-based half-open UTF-8 bytes. body_* refers to jats_to_text applied to an article containing ONLY the original JATS body. stored_* refers to the committed source. Segments are concatenated with two LF bytes and a final LF; no abstract is included.
